description: Search the live catalog of Gameshop Enter — original retro Nintendo games, consoles, PlayStation 4/5 games and Pokémon TCG, all personally tested, shipping to all 27 EU countries plus Monaco, to 41 countries outside the EU with their own store (US, CH, AU, NZ, HK, SG, LI, IL, AE, SA, QA, KW, CA, PR, CL, GB, MX, NO, PH, MY, CO, PE, IS, OM, BH, EC, CR, KR, ZA, MA, BR, TW, TH, JP, IN, DO, GT, SV, PA, HN, AR) and to 150 more countries worldwide. Understands abbreviations ("gba"), Dutch and English game names, typos, and Pokémon version names in German, French, Italian and Spanish ("pokemon feuerrot", "pokémon rubis"). Returns products with price in EUR, stock status, the product-page URL (url) and a direct checkout link (checkoutUrl) that puts the item in the cart and opens checkout. Pass the buyer's country to get the product pages of that country's own store with the price in its currency (local), or the product pages in the buyer's language.

country.description: Optional ISO-2 country of the buyer, e.g. "SG", "US", "AU", "DE". A country with its own store (US, CA, AU, NZ, SG, HK, CH, IL, AE, SA …) gets url on that store and, where that store charges in its own currency, local with the price in it (SGD for SG); another country gets url in its own language (German for DE). Where a country has a product page in its own language on top of its store (e.g. TR Turkish, VN Vietnamese, NO Norwegian, HK Chinese), url is that page at the same price, with englishUrl for the same offer in English. Omit for the Dutch product page in EUR.

platform.description: Optional platform filter, e.g. "Game Boy Advance", "N64", "Switch"; abbreviations work too (ds, 3ds, gba, gbc, snes, nes, wii, wii u, gamecube, ps4, ps5, tcg). "ds" means Nintendo DS only (not 3DS), "wii" means Wii only (not Wii U).

query.description: Game title, character, franchise, console or SKU — pass the buyer's own wording, in any language (pokemon gold and silver, cheap gba games, nintendo ds lite). Results are ordered best match first.
